business_justification:
The Postal Service has been offering promotions/incentives (postage price discounts) since 2012 to maintain/grow the value of mail by incentivizing mailers to adopt new technologies and techniques to drive mail innovation and effectiveness.  Over the years, the promotion/incentive programs have demonstrated that they maintain the value and effectiveness of mail.  Examples of the technologies/techniques mailers have been incentivized to adopt include but are not limited to: the integration of digital technology and physical mail; improving the quality and appeal of mail by using new print technology and techniques; and increasing personalization and better targeting for higher ROIs.  

The general intent of all promotions is to increase the value of direct mail and retain the volumes of transactional mail thereby assuring long-term product growth. Analysis of past promotion participation has shown that mailers who participate in promotions have higher volume growth than non-participants.

Predicting the success of the approved 2026 promotions, we are planning for the 2027 Promotion Calendar.
technical_implementation: MuleSoft sends a CRID parameter to an API supported by a Databricks App. The service queries the referenced table and returns a JSON response containing only records where the table CRID equals the MuleSoft-provided CRID.
